answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 6477 Country: ZA Title: What is the state of meat slaughterd by jews in palestine, halal or haraam? Question: What is the state of meat slaughterd by jews in palestine, halal or haraam? Answer ID: 6477 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1604/1227=H/1429) We are not particularly aware of the religious conditions of the Jews in Palestine , but generally as per their concepts against their religion, the expert Ulama regard it haram and prohibited. There is some detail in the Translation of the Quran by Hazrat Shaikhul Hind and its notes, you can see it in under the first some verses of Surah Al-Maaidah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
